prompt: Create a polished desktop inventory application screen for an Argentine bookstore named CoLibri. All UI in Spanish. This is the main screen INICIO / BUSCAR LIBROS, desktop 1440px wide. Design a real working desktop application visual, not an ecommerce storefront. Palette violet #6D28D9, cool magenta #C026D3, pale lavender #F6F3FC, white cards, deep plum readable typography, turquoise accents #0891B2. Generous whitespace, refined Inter / editorial serif headings, clear controls. Only TOP horizontal navigation: small bookstore logo and CoLibri on left; Inicio, Libros, Administración dropdown with eight options (Géneros, Subcategorías, Editoriales, Formatos, Ubicaciones, Estados, Idiomas). Count is seven options, use all seven named labels. No sidebar. Far right prominent Agregar libro button. Main upper section: actual supplied logo in a square image approx 130x130 on left, heading Tu próxima lectura está acá and subtitle Buscá y administrá los títulos de tu librería. Beside/below large search input Buscar por título o autor/a and Buscar button, filter controls Género, Subcategoría, Editorial, Estado. Keep search primary and results near it. Lower white table titled Libros with columns Título, Autor/a, Editorial, Precio de venta, Stock, Estado, action Editar. Title and author MUST be separate columns. Each row is a TITLE; stock is number of copies, editable through book edit. Include 4 believable sample rows (El profeta / Gibran Khalil Gibran / Kier / $ 18.500,00 / 1 / Disponible; El día que apagaron la luz / Camila Fabbri / Seix Barral / $ 24.000,00 / 1 / Disponible; El coleccionista / Nora Roberts / Debolsillo / $ 21.500,00 / 1 / Disponible; Cuba Stone, tres historias / Javier Sinay, Joselo y Jeremías Gamboa / Tusquets / $ 19.800,00 / 1 / Disponible). Prices illustrative. Caption Datos de ejemplo. No delete-book button, no ISBN, no cost, no purchase, no sales dashboard charts, no accounts/login/profile, no invented sales operations. Footer subtle 4 títulos · 4 ejemplares, table pagination tasteful. Use the real logo image unchanged. Below is its complete data URL. Embed it as an img src directly, not a recreated logo, not stock imagery. Logo is olive with original typography and hummingbird; retain its original colors while rest of UI uses purple/magenta. If logo data cannot be embedded, use img src colibri.jpg as placeholder for local exported preview; do not invent a logo. LOGO_DATA_URL: data:image/jpeg;base64,
